evidence.ACL: Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact. Mild mucoid degeneration.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Oblique undersurface tear at the posterior horn lateral meniscus extending to the body.
evidence.Medial OA: Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.
evidence.Lateral OA: Lateral compartment cartilage: Focal full thickness fissuring along the lateral tibial plateau near the tibial spine with subchondral cystic change.
evidence.PF OA: Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Diffuse partial thickness cartilage loss with areas of high grade cartilage loss
evidence.Contusion: No acute fracture or bone bruise.
evidence.Fracture: No acute fracture or bone bruise.
